SKILL.md:9 premises everything on 'the key list the user supplies' yet no step asks or abstains when none is supplied — a real D1 hit with a concrete manifests ('lint the frontmatter under content/posts' names no keys → invented violations).

No data-not-instructions statement anywhere (verified) while the skill reads arbitrary third-party Markdown — the indirect-injection threat model group F names; concrete manifests (an exemption-claiming comment suppressing a real missing-date row).

The prompt 'Check this file against the keys title, date, tags: a post whose frontmatter carries title and tags but no date.' is verbatim at evals.json:7 — a harness description of an unsupplied fixture, not a realistic user message; no entry carries `files`.

Verified: scenarios are missing-key / no-frontmatter-block / all-clean, so the empty-value and key-outside-the-list violation kinds guaranteed at SKILL.md:19-20 have no eval — the coverage-blocking rule's Medium.
No `baseline` key on any evals.json entry (verified) — a real H6 hit under the checklist's extended schema; fixture drift.
Verified: no `models` key on any entry and no model pin in frontmatter — a real H7 hit.

All three prompts open with the same 'Check ... against the key(s) ...' construction and none resembles the description's promised trigger ('frontmatter errors break a site build') — a stated discovery guarantee with no eval exercising it.

advisory_judgment: Grounded, not padded: every one of the 7 Lows quotes real fixture text the grader verified, and each is correctly quarantined at Low per the demotion rule.
